mainText: From Kiwi Kids News: Record-breaking chess game on mountaintop. Two American best friends have set a Guinness World Record by playing a game of chess at the top of a mountain in Ecuador. Adam Wininger, 32, and Joshua Host, 44, played on the summit of Chimborazo, in the Bolívar region of Ecuador, on 31 March 2026.

titleText: Pakistan’s first astronaut boards China’s space station
mainText: From Kiwi Kids News: Pakistan’s first astronaut boards China’s space station. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali has become the first person from Pakistan to travel into orbit, and the first astronaut from outside China to visit its Tiangong space station. The 40-year-old blasted off on a Chinese-made rocket from the Jiuquan Satellite Launch Centre in northwest China, and docked at the space station early on Wednesday.

titleText: UK immigration has fallen, but what does that mean
mainText: From BBC Newsround: UK immigration has fallen, but what does that mean. UK immigration is the lowest its been for years, but what is immigration and why does this matter?

From News for Kids: Earthshot Prize Announces 2026 Winners. England's Prince William and Princess Catherine recently visited Mumbai, India to announce the winners of the sixth Earthshot Prize. The prize is a special award that gives money and support to people who are finding new ways to protect our planet. Five winners each received £1 million (about $1.3 million) to help their projects grow.

titleText: Voyager 1 Spacecraft is One “Light Day” From Earth
mainText: From News for Kids: Voyager 1 Spacecraft is One “Light Day” From Earth. Last Wednesday, the space probe Voyager 1 reached a milestone that sounds like something out of a science fiction movie. It became the first human-made object to reach a distance of one "light-day" from Earth. Voyager 1 is now so far away that it takes light a full day to travel from Earth to the spacecraft.
